major_cooldowns.name: Tranquility
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use it during heavy raid damage or when your raid leader calls for it, and get several Rejuvenations, a Wild Growth, and some Regrowth heal-over-time effects out first so the 10-second extension has more to work with.

major_cooldowns.name: Convoke the Spirits
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use it often during the most dangerous moments of the fight rather than saving it, since it is a short cooldown that mixes random Wild Growths, Swiftmends and Rejuvenations.

major_cooldowns.name: Nature's Swiftness
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Save it for an instant, empowered Regrowth to save someone who has dropped low.

major_cooldowns.name: Innervate
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Self-cast it starting around 75 percent mana and fit as many casts into the fight as possible.

major_cooldowns.name: Ironbark
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use it often on anyone about to take heavy damage rather than holding it for a special occasion, since its cooldown is short.

major_cooldowns.name: Incarnation: Tree of Life
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use it as your longer-duration alternative to Convoke the Spirits: it boosts all healing, gives Wild Growth extra targets, makes Regrowth instant, and buffs Wrath damage.
major_cooldowns.id_note: NOT observed in the sampled parses (choice-node alternative to Convoke the Spirits); id confirmed against the guide's own spell=33891 reference.

defensives.name: Barkskin
defensives.usage_rule: Use it whenever you are in danger; its low cooldown means you should not hold onto it.

rules.description: Regrowth only while Abundance is active
rules.action: Build up 5 Rejuvenation stacks for Abundance before you start chain-casting Regrowth.

rules.description: Spend Soul of the Forest procs on Regrowth
rules.action: Cast Regrowth as soon as Soul of the Forest procs instead of letting it expire.
Reapply Lifebloom to yourself before it falls off so your Apex healing keeps scaling.
Follow every Swiftmend with a self-cast Rejuvenation so it spreads to three targets.
